decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans BUTT/PLAN/01A, BUTT/PLAN/02A and Design and Access Statement received 30th September 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The fume extraction system shall be provided, before the restaurant use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
description: Installation of external ducting for extractor fan to restaurant premises.
